# Purpose
This generated header defines the metric metadata for the shred subsystem. It maps each metric to a fixed offset, name, type, description, converter, and, for histograms, value limits, so the metrics framework can store and read values in a stable layout. The file groups counters and histograms for shred processing, FEC set handling, rejection cases, and timing data, which lets the application report operational state and performance for this part of the system. The `FD_METRICS_SHRED` table and `FD_METRICS_SHRED_TOTAL` constant provide the complete metric set for use by the metrics runtime, while the include guard and generated-file notice prevent manual edits and control repeated inclusion.
